exemplos.summary: Integration of the JT-60SA Actively Cooled Divertor
exemplos.content: Integration of the JT-60SA Actively Cooled Divertor

description:
The scope of this contract is divided into service and hardware. The service
encompasses tasks such as storage, assembly, welding, installation, and inspection of the
divertor components and diagnostic components. The hardware involves the production and/or
acquisition of Langmuir probes, Halo current (Rogowski) coils, Thermocouples, Gas injection
pipes, Electrical shunts, Diagnostic connectors, Divertor fasteners, Divertor alignment
components, Main water pipe caps.
title: Integration of the JT-60SA Actively Cooled Divertor

description: JRC Petten seeks for part-time technical assistance in support of Infra by a Project Support Officer who shall be mainly dealing with, but not limited to, the small and medium-sized projects.  The scope includes support during the full project lifecycle: needs definition, scoping, technical specification review , technical specifications development (if agreed) , procurement support, execution supervision, commissioning, handover and administrative closure.
